identity.title: [tooling][csdlc-v2] Implemented-phase card recovery cannot repair review-blocking SPP/STP truth

values.task_boundary: C-SDLC v2 tooling only: csdlc-edit/card/store behavior and focused tests for implemented-phase recovery truth repair.
deliverables: typed implemented-phase recovery support for SPP step status truth
typed implemented-phase recovery support for STP dependency truth
acceptance_criteria: AC1: A typed recovery request can repair implemented-phase SPP plan-step statuses including completed and in-progress truth when generation/digest evidence matches.
AC2: A typed recovery request can repair implemented-phase STP dependencies when review evidence identifies omitted dependencies.
AC3: The recovery path rejects stale CAS, unsupported phases, review/publication/terminal-incompatible states, duplicate or malformed steps/dependencies, and unrelated card fields.
AC4: Audit history records old/new SPP/STP truth without deleting prior review or implementation evidence.
AC5: Existing review, publication, and terminal authority guardrails remain intact and covered by focused tests.
